rv.q: This is a humorous, well-crafted piece which deserves its extended outing.
The Constant Wife is a witty and thoughtful production that reminded me a little of Oscar Wilde or George Bernard Shaw around the edges.

Review: The Constant Wife (Touring) Monday 26th January 2026 at York Theatre Royal ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The Constant Wife by Laura Wade (based on the comedy by W Somerset Maugham) is a sharp, well-observed comedy of manners.

cn.t: Critics praise Laura Wade's sparkling adaptation of Maugham's 1926 comedy, finding it both very funny and surprisingly layered. Kara Tointon leads the touring production in a light, engaging take on a wife quietly securing her own power.
